positions.title: Full-Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
▪	Worked as a full-stack web developer for RetGrid (http://retgrid.com), building a minimum viable product for a web application that allows agents to coordinate the whole buying process with their clients. The application allows buyers and their agents to search MLS data, save searches, plan home tours, exchange notes about properties, track buyer favorites, follow-up communications among buyers, buyers agents, listing agents, and initiating and tracking transactions to completion. The site aggregates data from the Multiple Listing Service (MLS), GreatSchools, state licensing boards, etc..
▪	Implemented a SPA/ASP.Net MVC web application backed by Microsoft SQL Server database exposed via RESTful Web API. Web client employs AngularJS, responsive web design for desktop, tablet and mobile devices. Agile development process with daily standups and Trello for task management.
▪	Visual Studio 2015, SQL Server Management Studio, Team Foundation Server (TFS), Chrome Developer Tools, JSON Lint, C#, Transact-SQL, JavaScript, MVC 5, Web Api 2.0, JSON Serialization, AJAX, jQuery, AngularJS, Bootstrap 3.0, CSS3, Google Maps, AWS S3, MVC Attribute Routing and Trello.
▪	Personally implemented the import from Multiple Listing Service API, complex search functionality, file upload to AWS S3 and Transaction Template subsystem.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Framework · C# · jQuery · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · ASP.NET MVC · AJAX · Bootstrap · SQL

positions.title: Statistical data analyst
positions.description:
▪	Imported and cleaned large data sets in SAS; analyzed and coded demographic combinations.
▪	Supported analysis of data by programming cross tabulation, matrix and rank tables for researchers.
▪	Edited and analyzed team members' coded data, toplines, cross-tabulation, matrix and rank tables.
▪	Reviewed toplines, cross-tabulations, matrix and rank tables to ensure that data was accurate.

positions.title: Digital Media Coordinator
positions.description:
-Analyze weekly revenue and impression reports to tackle and eliminate discrepancies amongst our advertisers.
-Interpret data to assist the Director of Business Development in enhancing advertiser relationships. 
-Identify necessary media buys and strategically test traffic to ensure profitability. 
-Manage internally owned and 3rd party sites to increase view ability which adds value to our traffic.  
-Leading the transition of existing campaigns to a new ad serving system.
-Reduce the set up time of 3rd party tags by researching and understanding creative codes. 


positions.title: E! International Marketing
positions.description:
-Utilize excel to organize large sets of promo footage information.
-Communicate and work with Producers on marketing campaigns.
-Compose lists of possible music and footage selection for promos.
-Maintain promo library.

positions.title: Sports Marketing
positions.description:
-Assisted the highlights Coordinator in labeling and organizing game melts.
-Optimized online searches for material pertaining to promos. 
-Provided production support for marketing campaigns and individual promo spots.
-Maintained footage library.

positions.title: Student assistant
positions.description:
-Researched patient medical insurances to better manage their medical care. 
-Coordinated patient appointments. 
-Prepared patient charts for next day appointments.
-Organized and maintained patient charts.
-Managed office phone calls.
